title: The Implementation of Rewind in Braid
summary: Jonathan Blow's GDC talk explains how the time-rewind mechanic in Braid was designed and implemented, including the technical hurdles such as memory limits and state history. It covers both design and engineering concerns.
why: HN commenters cite it as the reference for how a rewind system works and as a point of comparison for undo and serialization approaches.

quote.text: Here's a GDC talk about the rewind system in which he explains some of the hurdles he had to deal with
